using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_CallsHttpClientGetAsync_WhenNotActiveQuery()
		{
			// Arrange
			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var mockHttpClientFactory = new Mock<Func<HttpClient>>();
			mockHttpClientFactory.Setup(f => f()).Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

			var mockWidget = new Mock<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var mockModData = new Mock<OpenRA.ModData>(MockBehavior.Strict);
			var onJoin = new Mock<Action<OpenRA.Server.GameServer>>(MockBehavior.Strict);

			var logic = new TestableServerListLogic(mockWidget.Object, mockModData.Object, onJoin.Object, mockHttpClientFactory.Object);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Wait a bit for the Task.Run to execute
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Assert
			mockHttpClientFactory.Verify(f => f(), Times.Once);
			mockHttpClient.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_DoesNotCallHttpClient_WhenActiveQuery()
		{
			// Arrange
			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			var mockHttpClientFactory = new Mock<Func<HttpClient>>();
			mockHttpClientFactory.Setup(f => f()).Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

			var mockWidget = new Mock<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var mockModData = new Mock<OpenRA.ModData>(MockBehavior.Strict);
			var onJoin = new Mock<Action<OpenRA.Server.GameServer>>(MockBehavior.Strict);

			var logic = new TestableServerListLogic(mockWidget.Object, mockModData.Object, onJoin.Object, mockHttpClientFactory.Object);
			logic.SetActiveQuery(true); // Simulate active query

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert - should not call factory or client
			mockHttpClientFactory.Verify(f => f(), Times.Never);
			mockHttpClient.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Never);
		}
	}

	// Test double to expose HttpClient dependency for testing the GetAsync call on line 460
	public class TestableServerListLogic : ServerListLogic
	{
		public readonly Func<HttpClient> HttpClientFactory;

		public TestableServerListLogic(OpenRA.Widgets.Widget widget, OpenRA.ModData modData, Action<OpenRA.Server.GameServer> onJoin, Func<HttpClient> httpClientFactory)
			: base(widget, modData, onJoin)
		{
			HttpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
		}

		public void SetActiveQuery(bool active)
		{
			activeQuery = active;
		}

		protected override HttpClient CreateHttpClient()
		{
			return HttpClientFactory();
		}
	}
}

	// Test double exposing HttpClient dependency

		}

		}
